subject: Co-sell ops: CloudForge marketplace + joint sell playbook
messages:
From: Heather Nguyen <heather@cloudforge.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Joint marketplace + co-sell idea (CloudForge x Redwood)

Hi Ben —

Quick intro: I’m Heather, Head of Alliances at CloudForge. We’ve been piloting a reference integration with Acme Analytics (Jared on cc) that pairs their analytics pipeline with Redwood’s hosted inference for embeddings and reranking. The pilot lift looked strong and Acme is asking for a co-sell listing to accelerate procurement.

We’d like to:
- Publish a marketplace listing (GCP + Azure initially) that bundles our connector + Redwood Dedicated offering as a "validated bundle"
- Add a co-sell tag and request listing visibility for partner-led opportunities
- Align on technical evidence + billing mapping for joint offers

Attached: cloudforge-joint-playbook-v1.docx (draft), acme-reference-pipeline.csv (anonymized usage).

Asks:
1) Can Redwood own the marketplace listing ops with CloudForge as publisher co-owner?
2) Who at Redwood can triage technical evidence for GCP listing (authentication + metering)?
3) Are there typical SLA / pricing expectations for partner bundles?

Happy to hop on a 30-min sync this week.

Thanks!
Heather Nguyen
Head of Alliances, CloudForge
heather@cloudforge.io

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Heather Nguyen <heather@cloudforge.io>, Jared Kim <jared@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace + co-sell idea (CloudForge x Redwood)

Hi Heather — great to meet you and congrats on the pilot momentum. Short answers up front: yes (we can co-manage listing), I’ll loop in our marketplace and engineering leads, and we have a partner bundle framework that usually works for this pattern.

Next steps I suggest:
- Internal triage: Vivek and Olga to validate technical evidence + metering mapping (see attached checklist)
- Commercial: we’ll draft a mutual action plan and map pricing/commitment classes for the bundle (monthly reserved vs metered)
- Marketplace ops: Redwood will start a draft listing but CloudForge needs to confirm co-publisher details and logo assets

I attached redwood-marketplace-checklist.pdf — Vivek / Olga, can you review and flag gaps? Heather / Jared — can you confirm whether Acme prefers Azure or GCP first?

I’m free for a 30-min sync tomorrow 10–11am PT if that works.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-checklist.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Heather Nguyen <heather@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Jared Kim <jared@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2029-05-20T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace + co-sell idea (CloudForge x Redwood)

On 2029-05-20 09:15, Heather Nguyen wrote:
> Quick intro: I’m Heather, Head of Alliances at CloudForge. We’ve been piloting a reference integration with Acme Analytics (Jared on cc)...

Thanks — digging into the attachments now. A few technical clarifications before we spin up formal evidence:

- Authentication model: Is CloudForge using OAuth2 service accounts per-customer or a multi-tenant API key model? For GCP listing evidence we need a reproducible auth flow and example token exchange steps.
- Metering signal: The acme-reference-pipeline.csv is helpful; we need a mapping doc showing which CloudForge event maps to Redwood meter (embedding units / inference-seconds). This determines SKU mapping in the listing.
- Private vs hosted: If we include Redwood Dedicated as part of the bundle, procurement differs (reserved capacity contract + co-term). If CloudForge wants hosted API credits instead, the listing SKU and pricing will change.

Immediate asks for CloudForge:
1) Short doc with auth flow and sample HTTP calls (one-page)
2) Event-to-meter mapping table (CSV)
3) Preferred initial region (us-west1 / europe-west1)

Olga: once we have the auth/metering piece I’ll take point on the GCP evidence binder. I’ll also set up a Confluence page for the bundle artifacts.

Vivek
Senior Product, Redwood Inference

From: Heather Nguyen <heather@cloudforge.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared@acme-analytics.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, GCP Partner Team <gcp-partner@google.com>
Date: 2029-05-21T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace + co-sell idea (CloudForge x Redwood)

Thanks Vivek — attaching an updated playbook with the auth snippet and a simple event-to-meter mapping (cloudforge-joint-playbook-v1.docx). We use per-customer OAuth2 service accounts for Acme in the pilot, which is reproducible.

Highlights from the attached:
- Auth: service-account flow, example jwt exchange, sample curl calls in section 2.1
- Metering: CloudForge emits a "document_batch_processed" event; we've mapped that to Redwood embedding-units in the attached CSV.
- Regions: Acme prefers GCP us-west1 for latency.

We’re happy to provide a sandbox account for evidence collection. Re: pricing model — CloudForge prefers a hybrid approach: small reserved pool + metered overage. Happy to align on the mutual action plan in the next call.

Attachment: cloudforge-joint-playbook-v1.docx

Best,
Heather

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Heather Nguyen <heather@cloudforge.io>, Jared Kim <jared@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, GCP Partner Team <gcp-partner@google.com>
Date: 2029-05-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace + co-sell idea (CloudForge x Redwood) — plan and owners

Team — thanks, all looks good. Quick confirmation of next steps and owners so we can lock dates: 

1) Evidence & listing: Vivek / Olga to assemble GCP evidence binder (target: 2029-05-29). CloudForge will provide sandbox creds and a small dataset (Heather).
2) Pricing & commercial: Ben to draft mutual action plan and pricing tiers; initial offering = reserved 4 GPU-hours / mo + metered embedding units (signup credit). Draft due 2029-05-24 (mutual-action-plan.xlsx attached).
3) Marketplace ops: Redwood will create the draft listing and request co-publisher status; GCP Partner Team, please advise on publisher co-ownership steps and required fields.
4) Co-sell enablement: CloudForge to provide two customer reference quotes (Acme is one) and a 20-min demo script for the partner playbook.

Heather/Jared — are you available for the 30-min sync tomorrow 10am PT to review the MAP and GCP evidence ask? If yes I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the DocuSign link for a non-binding mutual NDA to speed evidence exchange (link below).

DocuSign (mutual NDA): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&token=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4821
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1A2B3CloudForgePlaybook

Thanks — Ben
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
